settings.name_in_paper: Contextual stochastic partial monitoring, globally observable games (online oracle)
unmapped: Finite partial monitoring game (L, Phi) known to learner, loss matrix in [0,1]^{k x d}, feedback alphabet size m

Access to an online outcome-estimation oracle with Hellinger regret bound Reg_On(Q,T,delta)
settings.definition_quote: At round $t$ the learner observes a context $x_t$ (which may be chosen adversarially), samples an action $A_t \sim p_t(\cdot \mid x_t)$ ... the environment draws an outcome $O_t$ from some stochastic distribution $q^{\ast}(x_t)$ ... $\mathrm{Reg}_T := \sum_{t=1}^{T} ( p_t^\T \boldsymbol{L} q^{\ast}(x_t) - \min_{\lambda \in \Delta(k)} \lambda^\T \boldsymbol{L} q^{\ast}(x_t) )$.

symbols.Reg_On: Hellinger regret bound of the online estimation oracle, Reg_On^H(Q,T,delta)

conditions: online oracle has Hellinger regret bound Reg_On

source.label: theorem_doec_regret
source.quote: Suppose $\mathrm{Alg}_{\mathrm{On}}$ has a Hellinger regret bound $\overline{\mathrm{Reg}}_{\mathrm{On}}^{\mathrm{H}}( \mathcal{Q}, T, \delta )$. Fix $\gamma > 0$. Then, for any $\delta \in (0,1)$, with probability at least $1-\delta$, $\mathrm{Reg}_T \leq T \cdot \max_{t=1}^T \mathcal{V}_{\gamma}(\hat{q}_t(x_t), p_t ) + \gamma \cdot \overline{\mathrm{Reg}}_{\mathrm{On}}^{\mathrm{H}}( \mathcal{Q}, T, \delta )$.

results.notes: Meta theorem for E2D.PMSide with any exploration rule; attached to the globally observable setting/algorithm a1 for lack of a generic algorithm entry. Regret defined through expected loss p_t^T L q*(x_t).

online oracle with Hellinger regret bound

source.label: corollary_regret_e2d_global
source.quote: Then, for any $\delta \in (0,1)$, and for any large enough $T$ that satisfies $\gamma > 16 k^2 \beta^2$ with $\gamma = ( T k \beta / \overline{\mathrm{Reg}}_{\mathrm{On}}^{\mathrm{H}}(\mathcal{Q}, T, \delta) )^{2/3}$, with probability of at least $1-\delta$, \edpm run with Alg~\ref{alg:explore-go} as the exploration rule satisfies, $\mathrm{Reg}_T \leq O( \sqrt[3]{T^2k^2\beta^2\overline{\mathrm{Reg}}_{\mathrm{On}}^{\mathrm{H}}(\mathcal{Q}, T, \delta) })$.

results.notes: Text: with finite Q and Vovk's algorithm (Reg_On = 2 log(|Q|/delta)), bound O((T^2 k^2 beta^2 log|Q|)^(1/3)); noncontextual Q = Delta(d_Q) gives O_tilde((T^2k^2beta^2 d_Q)^(1/3)). Computationally efficient given the oracle.

symbols.m_sig: size of the feedback symbol alphabet
symbols.Reg_On: Hellinger regret bound of the online oracle Reg_On^H(Q,T,delta)

conditions: locally observable, non-degenerate, no duplicate actions

source.label: corollary_regret_e2d_local
source.quote: Let Assumption~\ref{assumption_ono_degen} hold, and suppose in addition that the game is locally observable. Then, for any $\delta \in (0,1)$, with probability of at least $1-\delta$, \edpm run with Alg.~\ref{alg:explore-lo} ... with $\gamma = ( T m^2 k^2 /\overline{\mathrm{Reg}}_{\mathrm{On}}^{\mathrm{H}}(\mathcal{Q}, T, \delta) )^{1/2}$ satisfies $\mathrm{Reg}_T \leq O( \sqrt{ T \cdot m^2 k^2 \cdot \overline{\mathrm{Reg}}_{\mathrm{On}}^{\mathrm{H}}(\mathcal{Q}, T, \delta) } )$.

results.notes: Finite Q with Vovk: O(sqrt(T m^2 k^2 log|Q|)); noncontextual Delta(d_Q): O_tilde(sqrt(T m^2 k^2 d_Q)).
